bio: Owner-chef Stéphane Cuzin has been at the helm of this street corner bistro with a distinctive red façade and a snazzy, modish interior for many years now. It faces Bergerac’s covered market, where Stéphane sources the majority of his ingredients. Creative recipes and unusual seasonings set the tone: tonka, nutmeg, cumin and coffee may underscore veal, spinach or asparagus....
